entries.3850afd8b59ed512: This is a business in which the group, as the investing entity, conducts investment activities. entries.790122a8ecd1c565: Under its corporate philosophy, "Always remain the best professionals," it sets "Client First," "Performance First," and "Compliance First" as its codes of conduct. In the Investment Management Business, it does not set assets under management as a management target indicator, and its policy is to provide investment services that put customer satisfaction first. In the Investment Banking Business, its policy is to selectively acquire small and mid-sized rental real estate and to expand its portfolio on a sustained basis through value-up and sale and reinvestment at optimal timing. It also says it is pursuing expansion of its business areas, including the Facility Operation Business and investment in the renewable energy field.
